name: telem
description: Telem web search and page fetch for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-provider web search and page fetch.
interface.longDescription: Telem routes web search across multiple providers and returns normalized, provider-attributed results. This plugin adds the Telem usage skill and sends query lineage with each call. The Telem MCP server itself is configured in config.toml by `npm create @telemai`.
